topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the practical context, historical perspective, and learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Cancer and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes through tumor virology and describe the experimental assays used to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Genetics of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classes of cancer genes and examine how specific mutations alter cell cycle control and cellular phenotype.

topics.label: Sources and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression, Hereditary Predisposition, and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how stepwise mutation accumulation drives cancer progression and how inherited mutations and evolutionary pressures shape tumor development.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, recommends further reading, and previews the next lecture.
